card.name: Units right after a quantity number
card.fires_on: The unit word (mg, g, hours, SD, point) straight after a number in a drug dose or measured amount, where a figure is being stated.

modes.label: Dose units
modes.description: mg or g right after a dose number in drug interaction or dosing text.
modes.example: Oral administration of ropinirole 2<< mg>> 3 times daily increased mean steady-state

modes.label: Other measures
modes.description: Hours, points, mmHg or SD after a number in a quantity statement.
modes.example: enrolled in school for 25<< hours>> or less per week

card.writes: It promotes Chinese words meaning 'a total of', 'as many as' or 'up to' that introduce an amount.
card.plain: It fires on the unit just after a number, as in '2 mg', where an amount is being given.
